history: cloth hall of 1626 (Staalhof), Episcopal congregation from 1771, neo-Gothic front possibly by J.J. Janssen, one of the first neo-Gothic facades in the Netherlands; smooth red brick with fine joints, pointed arches

notes: Scope is the BAG pand 0363100012171165 only. The front (122.5 deg) is measured from the straight-on and oblique photographs (scale ~64 px/m from the 11.08 m front width); left and right bays differ in the photographs (wide three-lancet window, taller left corner pier; narrower two-lancet window, lower right corner pier) and are modelled that way. Side (NE, SW) and rear walls are party walls with no photograph: plain 3DBAG brick, inferred, and the audit reports them as blank-wall warnings. The EPISCOPAL CHURCH plaque is left blank; no lettering is modelled. Frames in the photographs are hidden behind trees in the right bay, so the right window's lancet count (two) comes from the oblique view. No in-game shot: the game bundles are rebuilt by the integrator.
